Subject: Renewal QBR — roadmap demo coverage grid and backup host sign-up

Hi Alex,

Following up on our renewal QBR planning — we'd like to lock the roadmap demo and the run-of-show this week so we can distribute invites to execs and engineers. To keep the session tight and resilient, proposed plan:

- Target window: June 24–25, 2026 (we can compress to a single 90–120m slot if needed)
- Proposed primary cadence: 60m product + 30m technical deep-dive / Q&A
- Coverage asks: please confirm the primary presenters and nominate at least one backup host for each segment (product, technical).

I've attached an initial coverage grid (qbr-coverage-grid.xlsx) and a short runbook (runbook-stub.pdf). Can you:
1) Confirm preferred date/time range for execs (TZ and any blackout windows)
2) Upload an attendee list (roles + expected headcount)
3) Nominate backups or let me know if Redwood should provide one

If we can finalize by EOD Tuesday (6/9) we'll send the calendar and recording/privacy notes.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: qbr-coverage-grid.xlsx (spreadsheet), runbook-stub.pdf (2p runbook)
